add.issue.comment.md:
Theme switcher is finished and up for review as draft PR #11.

What landed:
- GUI_THEME properties are now getters that read --o-* CSS variables from :root, so JS-sourced colours repaint on theme switch without reload.
- Added --o-muted to keep dim2 distinct.
- Reverted root tsconfig lib to ["esnext"] with zero typecheck errors.
- Added a Playwright assertion that the command-palette scrim changes colour after applyTheme without reload.
- Updated README.md to describe live repaint.

Verification:
- npx tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.
- GUI e2e: 222 passed, 1 failed (fullscreen-lanes layout assertion, unrelated to theme).
- Unit suite: 2130 passed; 66 failures are all the environmental agent-guard push-to-main issue in temp repos.

Docker is down so container/collab suites were skipped.
